--- ## Walkthrough Replaced the variadic `ReconcileResultOption` builder with chainable `ReconcileResult` methods, renamed `WriteClusterOperatorConditions` to `WriteClusterOperatorStatus`, simplified `mergeConditions` to a boolean-only update indicator (preserving LastTransitionTime logic), and updated controller callsites and tests accordingly. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Status API core**
`pkg/operatorstatus/controller_status.go`|Removed the `ReconcileResultOption`/variadic options API; added `ReconcileResult.WithRequeueAfter(time.Duration)` chainable method; updated `ControllerResultGenerator` constructors to drop option params; renamed `WriteClusterOperatorConditions(...)` → `WriteClusterOperatorStatus(...)` and set `.WithUID(co.UID)` on apply config; simplified `mergeConditions(...)` to return only a `bool` and preserve/adjust `LastTransitionTime` without producing log data.| |**Tests for status logic**
`pkg/operatorstatus/controller_status_test.go`|Updated tests to use the chained `WithRequeueAfter` API; removed assertions about returned log data from `mergeConditions`; adjusted expectations to the new boolean-only update return; added `all conditions unchanged` case and `TestWriteClusterOperatorStatus`; added `newFakeClient` helper enabling status subresource and ClusterOperator scheme.| |**Controller callsite**
`pkg/controllers/revision/revision_controller.go`|Replaced call to `reconcileResult.WriteClusterOperatorConditions(...)` with `reconcileResult.WriteClusterOperatorStatus(...)`; preserved existing error wrapping and requeue-related control flow.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes
✨ Finishing Touches
🧪 Generate unit tests (beta) - [ ] Create PR with unit tests
